findings.F1: The tested book's edge grows with the coin's 20-day volatility. On its active days, the next-day directional move net of drift is +0.01 % in the lowest volatility third (t −0.15, 781 cases), +0.38 % in the middle third (t 2.74, 781) and +0.60 % in the top third (t 3.58, 781), which is 5.5 times the 0.11 % round-trip cost. The long side has no edge at all in calm markets: its strength is −0.066 (t −1.07, 437) in the low third against +0.123 (t 2.48, 317) in the high third.
findings.F2: Volatility also decides what follows the moves the idea does not trade. Among 1-day falls of more than one usual move while the close is below its 50-day average, the correlation between the coin's volatility rank and the next-day rebound is 0.18 (t 3.86, 424 cases). In the lowest volatility third those falls keep falling (strength −0.40, t −1.96, 136 cases); in the top third they rebound (+0.18, t 2.07, 154).
findings.F3: Among 1-day rises of more than one usual move while the close is above its 50-day average, the correlation between volatility rank and the next-day give-back is 0.14 (t 3.19, 506 cases). In the lowest volatility third those rises keep going up the next day (give-back strength −0.31, t −2.59, 184 cases).
findings.F4: Below the 50-day average, the next-day fall grows with the size of the day's rise. Rises of 0.3 to 1 usual move are followed by −0.42 % (t −2.47, 525 cases), rises of 1 to 2 by −0.64 % (t −2.67, 206) and rises above 2 by −1.02 % (t −1.75, 50). The short side's give-back is still there on non-overlapping 5-day stretches: +1.38 % in its direction (t 2.23, 236 cases), against +0.61 % for the long side (t 0.93, 251).
findings.F5: Below the 50-day average, the more a coin has risen over the past 20 days, the more it falls over the next 3 days. On non-overlapping 3-day stretches the strength is −0.006 in the lowest 20-day-return third (t −0.09, 267 cases) and −0.178 in the top third (t −2.19, 265). This is the weakest pattern here, given how many angles were examined.
findings.F6: The long side fails in falling years. Its next-day directional move is −1.21 % in 2018 (t −1.90, 66 cases) and −1.14 % in 2022 (t −2.73, 82), against +0.42 % in 2023 (t 3.02, 221). Patterns by weekday are within the range of chance once the 14 groups examined are counted.

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's 1-day move against its 50-day average, measured in its 20-day usual moves, and the higher its 20-day volatility stands against its own past, the more of that move it gives back over the next 1 day.
ideas.consequence: A trader fading moves that run against the trend should expect the reversal to be paid mainly in volatile markets and should refuse the fade in calm ones.
ideas.name: volatility-graded counter-trend fade

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's vol-scaled 1-day fall while its close is below its 50-day average, and the higher its 20-day volatility against its own past, the more it rises over the next 1 day.
ideas.consequence: A trader can buy sharp down days even inside a downtrend when the market is turbulent, a case the tested idea leaves flat.
ideas.name: turbulent downtrend down-day rebound

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's vol-scaled 1-day rise while its close is below its 50-day average, the more it falls over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: A short taken against a rally inside a downtrend is worth holding for several days rather than one, which spreads the cost of the trade over a larger move.
ideas.name: downtrend rally five-day fade

ideas.idea: The lower a coin's 20-day volatility against its own past, the more its vol-scaled 1-day rise while its close is above its 50-day average continues over the next 1 day.
ideas.consequence: In a calm uptrend, a trader should follow a strong up day rather than fade it.
ideas.name: calm uptrend up-day continuation

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's 20-day return while its close is below its 50-day average, the more it falls over the next 3 days.
ideas.consequence: A strong month-long bounce inside a downtrend is a reason to short, or at least to refuse a long, for the following days.
ideas.name: downtrend bounce three-day fade
